incident.source_message_en: Due to traffic accident , part of the lanes of Wong Chuk Hang Road flyover (Aberdeen Tunnel bound) near Yip Kan Street is closed to all traffic. Only remaining lanes are available to motorists. Traffic is busy now.
incident.source_message_zh: 因交通意外，黃竹坑道天橋(往香港仔隧道方向)近業勤街的部份行車線現已封閉。 駕駛人士只可使用餘下行車線行車。 現時上址交通繁忙。
incident.notes: Lanes closed but not specified. No total lanes mentioned.

incident.source_message_en: Due to traffic accident , all lanes of Wong Chuk Hang Road flyover (Aberdeen Tunnel bound) near Yip Kan Street are closed to all traffic. Motorists are advised to use alternative routes such as Wong Chuk Hang Road. Traffic is busy now.
incident.source_message_zh: 因交通意外，黃竹坑道天橋(往香港仔隧道方向)近業勤街的全線現已封閉。 駕駛人士請考慮改用其他道路，例如黃竹坑道。 現時上址交通繁忙。
incident.notes: All lanes are closed due to the traffic accident.
